title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for the financial services industry?
summary: OpenText World 2026 has financial services covered! Join us for sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums tailored to the industry.
body_markdown:
Companies in the financial services industry have specific requirements, challenges, and pressures. You need a conference tailored to you with opportunities to hear about products that solve your specific needs, solicit advice from industry experts to tackle your unique challenges, and network with peers in similar situations.


[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*hsbl23*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mg..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODgyNzczNzkkbzYkZzEkdDE3ODgyOTAxMDIkajI3JGwwJGgxMTI4MDczNDgx) in Orlando, October 19–22, is that conference. The event’s financial services focus—including speaker sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and industry forums—offers insight and advice about what’s on your mind today and what to think about for tomorrow. Wondering how to deploy AI to improve customer service and make faster decisions? Not sure how your organization can build a trusted information foundation? Join us for answers to these questions and many more.


OpenText Financial Services Senior Industry Strategist Monica Hovsepian talks about what’s in store at OpenText World 2026.


New to this year’s conference are **Industry Advisory Boards** for banking and insurance. These focused gatherings bring together senior industry leaders to discuss trends, challenges, and innovation opportunities. Participation is open to interested attendees and subject to approval to ensure a curated peer-to-peer experience. More information is[here](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:b0383cbf-303c-4682-8546-a9e6973ac530) .


The conference also offers use cases, client success stories, how-to sessions, product roadmaps, roundtables, and more. Here are a few with a financial services lens that you won’t want to miss:


[Open possibilities: A client’s journey with OpenText Premium Support](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=85c813ff-a2c5-4b1a-ba06-31616df1237d&shareLink=true)


Tuesday, 11:30 a.m.


Hear about how an OpenText™ Premium solution support engineer helps CIBC US reduce risk and improve outcomes. You’ll learn why the bank chose this level of support, the challenges it solved, and the real-world impact on its business.


[Financial services industry forum](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=c5816f6f-8046-477a-a3dc-4b6805f8012b&shareLink=true)


Wednesday, 11:30 a.m.


Join peers from banking, insurance, and wealth management to explore what’s possible when AI moves from experimentation to enterprise scale. Hear examples of how organizations are applying AI and agentic AI to enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and support faster, more informed decisions.


[Banking without barriers: The connected corporate bank](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=adf572a7-4e2f-4cb0-83a1-d846ec504b40&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 9:00 a.m.


Explore how leading banks and corporations are moving beyond payment execution to connected ecosystems that integrate ERPs, banks, suppliers, customers, and payment networks through APIs, ISO 20022, and intelligent data orchestration.


[From execution to intelligence: Modernizing corporate-to-bank connectivity for the C-suite](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=7b993b06-54a0-4275-946b-a5b2359da862&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 9:45 a.m.


Discover how leading organizations are bridging the gap between physical supply chain triggers and downstream financial execution. Learn how an independent, enterprise-grade connectivity layer eliminates data silos, protects the SAP Clean Core standard, and creates a secure, AI-ready foundation for real-time cash visibility.


[Personalized communications: Turn every bill into an experience](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=67d06019-2125-41ae-b903-4931c6bd51c6&shareLink=true)


Thursday, 11:15 a.m.


Join us for a walkthrough showcasing the latest OpenText™ Communications products in an insurance environment. See how your organization can create and deliver clear, compliant, and highly personalized statements that transform routine communications into meaningful customer experiences.


Check our[webpage](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=7b993b06-54a0-4275-946b-a5b2359da862&shareLink=true) often for newly added sessions.
